inputs.text: They're at it again with this SSANU move, and it's no coincidence. The federal government has been stalling the renegotiation of that 2009 agreement on purpose to manufacture unrest in the universities as part of a bigger coordinated scheme by hidden elites. SSANU just issued a one-month ultimatum with threats of an indefinite nationwide strike if demands aren't met, all tied to their 54th National Executive Council resolutions. This is the usual elite manipulation to keep the system divided and under their control while pretending it's just about non-teaching unions.
